title: The Shawshank Redemption
admin_review: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency. A masterpiece of storytelling.

title: The Dark Knight
admin_review: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc on Gotham, Batman must face one of the greatest psychological tests. Heath Ledger's iconic performance.

title: Fight Club
admin_review: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club. A mind-bending journey with an unforgettable twist.

title: Forrest Gump
admin_review: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, the Vietnam War, and other historical events unfold from the perspective of an Alabama man. Tom Hanks at his best.

title: Interstellar
admin_review: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival. Stunning visuals and emotional storytelling.

title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
admin_review: Luke Skywalker joins forces with a Jedi Knight to rescue a rebel leader and save the galaxy. The movie that started it all!

title: The Matrix
admin_review: A hacker discovers that reality is not what it seems. Revolutionary special effects and mind-bending philosophy.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
admin_review: A meek Hobbit and his companions set out to destroy a powerful ring. Epic fantasy at its finest.
